elaine: Heads up — hit a replication issue in the node sampleapp when rotating project keys. app kept authenticating as the org key and user saw 403s during the rotation window.

mike: which sampleapp version and runtime? can you paste minimal repro?

elaine: sampleapp node v0.9.2, repro: set both envs then rotate project. our discovery order in JS checks REDWOOD_API_KEY before REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY, so when both exist it sticks to the org key. snippet:
```
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=org_live_ABC
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_OLD
# rotate the project key
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_live_NEW
node sampleapp.js # still authorizes as org_live_ABC
```

sam: oh no. I thought we standardized precedence last quarter. I remember python went project-first.

mike: we did in docs, but SDK implementations diverged. Current state: JS & Rust prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY first; Python prefers REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. That mismatch can silently break rotations.

terra: what about streaming / reconnect behavior? if a stream is open during rotation does reconnect pick up the new project key?

elaine: reconnect triggers credential discovery, but because JS discovery prefers org key, the reconnect re-auths as org key unless the project key is specified in explicit config. So rotation doesn't reliably apply on reconnect.

dev-bot: opened devex/sdk-credentials issue #4287: "Env precedence parity + streaming reconnect honor rotated project key" https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/issues/4287

mike: quick mitigation plan: 1) apply short-term sampleapp patch that prefers project key in code and logs which key was used; 2) unify SDK precedence to project-first (config override allowed); 3) add onboarding note about rotation semantics for long-lived connections.

sam: for the sampleapp patch could we have it emit a clear startup warning when both keys are set, with a link to a short FAQ? that should reduce support noise.

elaine: yup — draft PR ready with minimal change: detect both envs, log "Using REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY" or "Using REDWOOD_API_KEY" and when both are present print a short guidance link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/pull/691 (draft).

mike: I'll take JS + Rust precedence changes. Sam, can you own the sampleapp PR and product-facing docs? Terra, add an e2e that rotates a project key mid-stream and asserts reconnect uses the rotated project key.

terra: on it 9 I'll add a streaming test that performs a key rotation and verifies re-auth with the new project key.

sam: proposing a telemetry event `credential.shadow_detected` emitted when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY are present. helps us quantify how widespread this pattern is and whether we need a migration plan.

mike: good call. add as follow-up to #4287. if telemetry shows high volume we should send a targeted migration email via-console.

elaine: also adding a small note in the SDK README about rotation and long-lived streams so integrators know to set explicit project-key config for critical services.

mike: prioritize parity fix in next sprint. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
